highlights: Elara Securities (India) Private Limited Global Markets Research Lower JLR guidance; India PV resilient In Q2FY27, Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles (TMPV IN) consolidated revenue rose 34% YoY and 1% QoQ to INR 969bn.
JLR revenue rose 20.3% YoY to GBP 5.9bn, with adjusted EBIT margin at 1.4% (2.8% in Q1) and PBT before exceptional items of GBP 6mn (GBP 109mn in Q1).
India PV reported record revenue of INR 204bn, up 51.1% YoY, on 40% volume growth.
EBITDA margin was 4.0%, down 180bp YoY and 30bp QoQ, as commodity and FX cost offset price hikes & cost actions.
valuation: Management cut JLR’s FY27 target to EBIT margin of ~2-3% (from ~4%) and FCF outflow of ~GBP 1.3bn (from break-even).
We lower our FY27-29E EBITDA by 4-14% and lower our target price to INR 314.
China wholesale fell ~45% YoY, and management attributed revenue target cut primarily to China.
watch: Retain Accumulate with a lower TP of INR 314: We expect India business to be a key beneficiary of BEV penetration increasing in India from ~8% currently to ~18% in FY30E.

Management says Range Rover and Defender volume increased sequentially in Q2, rejecting concerns these models are becoming dated.  JLR — cash generation and investment cycle: Management expects cash generation to improve once the current investment cycle peaks and new product launches begin contributing to EBITDA.
